combinations.magnitude: transient relief 1 h post-injection versus QX-314 alone
combinations.evidence_quote: Coapplication of QX-314 with capsaicin transiently relieved tactile hypersensitivity an hour postinjection, compared with QX-314 alone (Fig. 1C), whereas coadministration of QX-314 with flagellin had no effect on pain behavior (Fig. 1D).
